page.replyDescription: Join the conversation with your account.
page.awaitingApproval: This post is awaiting approval. Only you and the moderators can see it.
page.deleted: This post was deleted. Only moderators can see it.
page.threadAwaitingApproval: This thread is awaiting approval. Only you and the moderators can see it.
page.threadDeleted: This thread was deleted. Only moderators can see it.
page.locked: This thread is locked. It no longer accepts replies.
page.lockedModerators: This thread is locked. Only moderators can reply.
page.cannotReply: You cannot reply to this thread.
page.contentClosed: The posts of this forum are not open to you. Only the title is shown.

errors.notThread: Enter the number or the address of a thread.
errors.noPosts: Select at least one post to split off.

moderation.removeCoverWarning: The cover is taken off the thread for good and nothing is refunded.
moderation.mergeLabel: The number or address of the thread to merge this one into
moderation.mergeWarning: Its posts move into that thread and this address opens it from now on. This cannot be undone.
moderation.splitHint: Pick the posts that should move to a new thread.
moderation.splitTick: Tick the posts to move, then name the new thread.
moderation.splitConfirm: Split off the selected posts now
moderation.hardDeleteWarning: The thread, its posts, reactions, files and reports are erased for good. Only its title and author stay in the moderator log. This cannot be undone.
moderation.hardDeleteMore: A large one is erased in steps. Some of it is still there: press the button again to carry on.

edit.heading: Edit post
edit.cannotDescription: This post can no longer be edited by your account.

uploads.failed: The file could not be uploaded.
uploads.tooLarge: This file is too large to upload here.
uploads.overLimit: This file is larger than the {size} MB the site allows.
